# Spec Metadata
## Rules
### Location
- `.specd/metadata/<workspace>/<capability-path>/metadata.json` via `specs.fs.metadataPath` or VCS-root derive / NullVcs fallback.
- Absence = no deps / no hash — not error.
### Sidecar / stamp
- Get schema/deps/impl via SpecRepository semantic ops — not raw sidecar files.
- `generatedMetadataStamp` = `{ present, lastModified }` only — not substitute for `metadata()`.
### Format (optional fields; empty/absent OK)
- title, description, keywords, dependsOn (projection of persisted deps), contentHashes, rules, constraints, scenarios, context, optimizedDescription/Context (from lock optimizations when fresh — omit if stale/absent), generatedBy always `"core"`, provenance.
### Provenance
- artifacts{hash,lastModified}, persistedStateHash, schema{name,version}, projectionVersion, projectionFingerprint. Freshness uses hashes/schema/version/fingerprint — never lastModified alone. contentHashes MUST match provenance.artifacts.
### Persist guard
- `PersistSpecMetadata` validates `strictSpecMetadataSchema` before write (title/description/contentHashes required). Internal only. Unknown keys passthrough.
### Archive-time generation
- Preflight extract+dependsOn consistency before any publish; post-publish GenerateSpecMetadata + persist. dependsOn from change.specDependsOn; extraction must match or fail.
### Freshness
- Only `assessMetadataFreshness(persisted, current)` — SpecRepository does not classify freshness. MaterializeSpecMetadata decides reuse vs regen.
### Consumers
- CompileContext etc. via GetSpecMetadata/MaterializeSpecMetadata — not raw readMetadataSnapshot for usability.
### VCS / implementation
- Disposable cache; default `/.specd/metadata/` gitignored. implementation.files / .symbols projected from persisted links when present.
## Constraints
- Not a schema artifact; never ValidateArtifacts/manifest-tracked.
- dependsOn projection only — never independently authored. No self-deps; cycles broken+warn on traversal.
- Access via readMetadataSnapshot/writeMetadataSnapshot — not artifact()/save(). Lock owns deps/impl/optimizations; metadata regenerable projection.
- parseMetadata lenient → {} on invalid.
